items.description: Kevin Harries is a professional male voice over actor offering broadcast-ready commercial, corporate, narration, IVR, eLearning and animation voice overs
Home page of Kevin Harries, voice actor for commercial and corporate work
Voice over demo reels: commercial, corporate, narration, animation, e-learning, IVR, explainers
Contact page for custom voice auditions, sound design projects and inquiries
About page describing Kevin Harries and his voice over and audio production services
Selected work: finished voice over projects for global brands (commercials, corporate, e-learning, animation)
Sound design services and demos: audio editing, Foley, mixing, soundscapes for film, games, commercials and branded media
Blog articles on voice over and sound design topics (corporate VO, documentaries, video games, VR, marketing, e-learning, accessibility), with a blog index page
Kevin Harries has documentary narration experience including true crime, nature, history and a 26-episode TV documentary series
Besides voice acting, Kevin Harries offers sound design services (Foley, mixing, audio editing, soundscapes)
The blog post 'The Marvellous Benefits of AI Voice Overs' is satire comparing AI voices to human voice actors and should not be read literally
